Definition: of uncertain origin; Manaën, a Christian:--Manaen.
BiblicalUsage: Manaḗn is Manaen, a prophet and teacher in the church at Antioch, named once in Acts 13:1. He had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, yet he stands in the list beside Barnabas, Simeon, Lucius, and Saul. A man raised beside a king ends up serving the King.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Manaḗn shows me that no upbringing decides a man's end, and I hold that God can take a companion of Herod and make him a teacher of the church.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
